regional_snapshot.coverage: Major-chain POIs mapped in OpenStreetMap within the specified rectangle covering Surrey, Delta, Richmond, Vancouver, Burnaby, Langley and surrounding communities. The rectangle includes parts of adjacent communities, including western Abbotsford, and is not an administrative Metro Vancouver boundary or a complete commercial directory.
limitations: Community-mapped records have not been individually verified with business operators. DATA_DATE is download date; OSM_TIMESTAMP is the last edit to that mapped object, not proof of a current or open business. No CHECKED_DATE is assigned.

Only explicit allowlisted chain names/brands/operators in seven selected categories are included. Independent businesses, untagged or missing branches, and categories outside this scope are omitted. Inclusion is not endorsement. The list now includes regional grocery, furniture, fitness and pharmacy chains as well as national brands.

The rectangular bounds do not match municipal boundaries and do not cover every part of Metro Vancouver or its adjacent communities. Nearest means nearest included mapped record, not necessarily the nearest real-world business.

Node positions and feature bounding-box centres are approximate; building, storefront, pedestrian and accessible entrances are unverified. No route, travel time, live opening hours, stock or service availability is provided.
Addresses and city names are preserved only when present in OSM. Missing addr:city values remain blank; city names are not inferred from approximate coordinates.
Known lifecycle/closed tags and closed names are excluded, but missing or stale closure information can remain. Former brands may remain in OSM until contributors update them.

Nearby duplicate node/way/relation records are conservatively merged within the same category and chain, with differing address/unit/branch references protected. Separate in-store pharmacies remain Pharmacy records. Some undetected duplicates may remain.

Walmart and Costco mapped as department stores/wholesalers are grocery destinations; this does not confirm grocery product range or an in-store pharmacy. Produce, bulk-food, frozen-food and selected convenience-store tags can identify grocery chains. Otter Co-op gas-bar convenience stores are excluded. Fitness-centre, sports-centre and fitness/yoga/pilates tags can include boutique fitness franchises. Furniture includes bedding and home-furnishing chains.
regional_snapshot.refresh_policy: One bounded POST per online run, no retries or runtime visitor calls; validation before atomic file replacement. HTTP errors, Overpass remarks, empty/small results, missing categories and decreases greater than 35% retain the published snapshot.

limitations: Regional OpenStreetMap data is community-maintained, not individually operator-verified. A download date is not an opening-status check.
Some branches may be missing, closed, misclassified or at approximate locations. Major-chain filtering intentionally omits independent shops.
Distances are straight lines to source points, not routes, entrance distances or travel times.
A ranked gap means no closer branch exists in this inventory; it does not prove no closer branch exists in the real world.
Recycling acceptance, access and fees follow the linked operator rules.
refresh: Review official additions/corrections in verified-places files.
Run python3 scripts/refresh_regional_places.py and scripts/refresh_public_facilities.py; failed refreshes preserve prior snapshots.
Refresh recycling, City amenity/transport and regional connection sources using their documented scripts; review provider counts and restrictions.
Run python3 scripts/refresh_sports_facilities.py and python3 scripts/refresh_city_sports.py; review closures and source exclusions.
Run python3 scripts/refresh_culture_places.py, scripts/refresh_nature_parks.py and scripts/refresh_national_parks.py; check access and source scope.
Run python3 scripts/refresh_schools.py and python3 scripts/refresh_childcare.py; review directory coverage, school grades and provider grouping.
Run python3 scripts/refresh_food_chains.py and python3 scripts/refresh_retail_services.py; review operator corrections, closures and branch duplicates.
Run python3 scripts/build_places.py and python3 scripts/build_portable.py.
Review category counts and nearest results for every pilot area before replacing a served release. No automatic schedule is enabled.
